annotations.title: Fund net assets and monthly returns (SEC filings)

description: Return what a fund's SEC filings state about its value: net assets at each Form N-PORT report month, each share class's monthly total return as reported, our own return index compounded from those months (base 100, not a NAV per share), and for closed-end funds the NAV per share and market price reported on Form N-CEN with the premium or discount. Where we hold a price for the class ticker it is shown as a market price on one venue, not NAV. Daily NAV per share is not served: no public filing carries it. Give a series id (S000002839) or a class ticker (VOO). Use it for a fund's size over time, monthly performance, or a closed-end fund's discount.

as_of.description: Knowledge date or timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339). The answer is what FinancialMD knew at that instant: only facts whose known interval contains as_of. Omit for the current view.

class.description: Class id C000... to return one class only.

limit.description: Maximum number of periods or items to return (default 36, at most 240).

name: fund_nav

outputSchema.description: The FinancialMD envelope (docs/API.md section 2): data plus meta (request_id, as_of knowledge time, matched company, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base). Every numeric value inside data is an object with value, unit, currency, period, known interval, restated flag, method and a proof pointing at the filing. On failure the result is isError with an error object instead.

data.description: { fund, matched_class, net_assets: [{ report_period, net_assets }], classes: [{ class_id, ticker, months: [{ month_end, total_return, index }] }], index, nav_per_share: [{ nav_per_share, market_price_per_share, premium_discount }], market_price, not_served, note }

error.description: Present only on isError results: the API error code and message plus remedy hints.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id, as_of, company resolution, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base.

attribution.description: Citations a source requires on anything shown from the answer.
